mapper.insert: insert into roam_poi (name, type, lat, lng, radius_m, address, description, xp, city_code, status, audit_status, application_type, tags, cover_img, gallery_json, photo_required, category, opening_hours, create_time) values (#{name}, 1, #{lat}, #{lng}, 80, #{address}, #{description}, 20, #{cityCode}, 0, 3, 3, #{tags}, #{coverImg}, #{galleryJson}, 1, #{category}, #{openingHours}, now())
mapper.select: select id, name, type, category, lat, lng, address, cover_img, tags, opening_hours, description, city_code, status, audit_status, template_id, create_time from roam_poi where type = 1 and merchant_id is null and city_code = #{cityCode} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into cms_topic (member_id, topic_type, product_type, name, description, address_name, location_count, template_count, total_mileage, status, user_status, lifecycle, del_flag, is_draft, publish_mode, journey_rules_json, create_by, create_time) values (#{memberId}, 1, 1, #{name}, #{description}, #{addressName}, #{locationCount}, #{templateCount}, #{totalMileage}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 'pro', #{journeyRulesJson}, #{createBy}, now())

insert into cms_topic_node (topic_id, chapter_id, name, description, address, longitude, latitude, img_url, template_id, sort_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{topicId}, 0, #{place.name}, #{place.description}, #{place.address}, #{place.lng}, #{place.lat}, #{place.coverImg}, #{templateId}, #{sortId}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.select: select n.id, n.topic_id as point_key, n.lat, n.lng, case when t.status = 1 and t.user_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end as flag1, case when n.template_id is not null and n.template_id > 0 then 1 else 0 end as flag2 from (select id, topic_id, template_id, cast(latitude as decimal(10,6)) as lat, cast(longitude as decimal(10,6)) as lng from cms_topic_node where latitude regexp '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' and longitude regexp '^-?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') n join cms_topic t on t.id = n.topic_id and t.del_flag = 0 where n.lat between #{minLat} and #{maxLat} and n.lng between #{minLng} and #{maxLng}

select m.id, cast(m.id as char) as point_key, m.location_lat as lat, m.location_lng as lng, case when exists (select 1 from roam_poi p where p.merchant_id = m.id and p.status = 1 and p.template_id is not null) then 1 else 0 end as flag1, 0 as flag2 from mms_merchant m where m.status = 1 and m.account_status = 1 and ifnull(m.del_flag, 0) = 0 and m.location_lat between #{minLat} and #{maxLat} and m.location_lng between #{minLng} and #{maxLng}

select null as id, p.board_id as point_key, p.latitude as lat, p.longitude as lng, case when b.lifecycle in ('READY', 'OPEN', 'FROZEN') then 1 else 0 end as flag1, 0 as flag2 from city_game_point p join city_game_board b on b.board_id = p.board_id where p.del_flag = 0 and b.lifecycle not in ('CLOSED', 'ARCHIVED') and p.latitude between #{minLat} and #{maxLat} and p.longitude between #{minLng} and #{maxLng}
select count(*) from growth_mission where status = '0' and daily_limit > 0

select count(*) from official_event where status in (1, 2, 3) and (activity_end is null or activity_end > now())
and (city is null or city like concat('%', #{cityKeyword}, '%'))

select board_id as boardId, title, region_id as regionId, lifecycle, map_south as south, map_west as west, map_north as north, map_east as east from city_game_board where lifecycle not in ('CLOSED', 'ARCHIVED') order by update_time desc limit 100
